detail.longDescription: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's dots. It's an always-on AI agent, which means that instead of waiting for you to type a prompt, it sends you a morning brief, checks your connected apps to see where it can be helpful, and works on tasks in the background. Terrifying? A bit. But before it sends, pays, signs, or deletes anything, it asks you first. It's still in research preview, but I got early access and spent some time with it on my phone.
